# serial-tool wasm probe

`serial-tool.mjs` and `serial-tool.wasm` are generated by
`scripts/build-serial-tool.py` from `serial-tool.c` plus
`scripts/serial-shim.c` with Emscripten 4.0.10. They are committed so CI can
run `test/serial-wasm.mjs` without an Emscripten install. Rebuild with the script and compare SHA-256 before accepting a change.

- serial-tool.wasm SHA-256: `3f60bb3bb3313cb773f3601a99484f1d273d55e4815bc0b2b3941606798975c3`

- serial-tool.mjs SHA-256: `f0a19bb5e041c89893c6430223de44aafbd1efa68396520d4670060cbf760c3c`
